versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service DynamicallyDefineDataIdenti- fier (0x2C), the Dcm module shall check if the DDDID can be defined in the current security level (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidReadSecurityLevelRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x33 (Security access denied).
